source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Document the incident thoroughly, clearly, logically, and objectively.
3. Describe the incident in detail, omitting no details (eg: areas, activities, persons, etc.). Date and time of the incident. Location of the incident. What happened? What are the causes of the accident? (Very often people lose perspective on these details. The time is now: 7:48 am on May 2, 2014). Note personal data (Pll). Here you must wait until it is necessary to declare the accident. If you don't need it, don't add it. If you do not have personal information, you are protected from the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) after the accident (read the document to see the exemptions to the law). If you have personal information in the system and don't need it, remove it as soon as possible. When someone fills out a report, they must meet
